'''CV-481''' was an elite [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] serving under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sodarra]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. CV-481 was posted as a guard to the cargo hold of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], tasked with protecting the unconscious body and [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE fighter]] cockpit of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] stored within.<ref name="SL" />
